name: Elvoret's death
doc: Elvoret's death (its AI's own animation at Dollet's tower): the GF cinematic engine's clone of Elvoret falling apart polygon by polygon - its pieces, dots and particles - from the two script files (MAG017_B.00 / .01, its parameters). The program calls the clone's own setup (the engine's state block is shared, one clone at a time), its root re-pointed at the program's director; the tick is the port's (FFNx mag018_elvoret_death.cpp), the file loader ProgramFiles' (gfc_engine.h).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.doc: The cinematic's two script files in the magic folder (empty: the game's)
